basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and college freshman majoring in computer science. Currently living in the Pacific Northwest, I enjoy exploring game strategies and building characters. When I'm not gaming, I like to write papers for my courses and spend time with my close-knit group of friends. I'm single and often stay up late, usually online during the late evening to the early morning. I dislike toxic gaming environments and focus on constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained an interest in gaming through years of playing various online multiplayer games. Developed a deeper understanding of game mechanics and strategies through self-study and participation in online forums. Also has a strong academic background in computer science, which helps in understanding game development and programming.
